subject: Mutual Action Plan & SOC2 evidence — kickoff and GRC introductions
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Horton <lauren.horton@acmetech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan & SOC2 evidence — kickoff and GRC introductions

Hi Lauren — thanks again for the demo last week. As discussed, we'd like to get a mutual action plan (MAP) in place to align timelines, decision makers, and evidence collection for your evaluation of Redwood Inference.

I've attached a draft MAP and a SOC 2 evidence checklist to seed the work. High level proposed milestones:
- Week 1 (this week): introductions + finalize MAP owners and dates
- Week 2: eval environment access + initial latency/cost checkpoints
- Week 3: SOC 2 evidence handoff and technical deep dive with security engineering
- Week 4: decision window and commercial alignment

To make this frictionless, can you introduce your GRC/security point of contact and the person who will own data handling and KMS-related questions? I'll loop in our internal owners: Marissa (GRC enablement) and Rishi (security ops). Mina from our infra team will be the data-handling POC once we have the right contact from your side.

Proposed next steps:
1) Lauren to confirm Acme GRC + legal contacts (preferably in a single reply)
2) We agree on owners and dates in the attached MAP (I can update live)
3) Set a 30-min kickoff call — Wed or Thu this week?

Thanks — looking forward to moving quickly.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
vivk.kulkarni@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0193

Attachments: MAP_Acme_Tech_Redwood_20260415.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOC2_evidence_checklist.pdf (PDF)

From: Lauren Horton <lauren.horton@acmetech.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@acmetech.com>, Elena Park <elena.park@acmetech.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan & SOC2 evidence — kickoff and GRC introductions

Hi Vivek — thanks for the summary and the docs. Bringing in our team:
- Sanjay Rao (GRC manager) — will own the SOC 2 evidence collection and compliance questions
- Elena Park (Senior Counsel) — will handle legal/contract redlines and data transfer terms

We're set up to run a 30-min kickoff Thursday 4/16 at 10:00am PT. If that works for your team, we'll use this thread as the MAP thread and Sanjay will start filling out the evidence checklist.

Couple of notes from Acme's side:
- Our SOC 2 team requires vendor attestation of SOC 2 Type II or a completed evidence package; we can accept a vendor-provided evidence bundle + snapshot of controls.
- For data handling, we have a dedicated cloud security engineer — Alex Moreno — who will join the technical deep dive next week. I'll introduce him in the follow-up.

See you on Thursday.

Best,
Lauren Horton
Director, IT Risk & Compliance
Acme Technologies
lauren.horton@acmetech.com | +1 (212) 555-6048

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Lauren Horton <lauren.horton@acmetech.com>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@acmetech.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Apr 2026 07:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan & SOC2 evidence — kickoff and GRC introductions

Thanks for the intro, Lauren.

Vivek — quick notes from our side:
- I'll act as the Redwood MAP owner and maintain the tracker; I'll update the attached spreadsheet after the kickoff with owners + dates.
- Rishi will lead the evidence pull and liaise with Sanjay on SOC 2 items. Rishi, can you confirm the expected list of artifacts you'd like first? Typical kickoff pack from Redwood: SOC 2 report (if available), infosec policy excerpts, encryption/KMS configuration summary, access logs retention statement, and a contact for incident response.

Mina Haddad (cc'd on this thread) is our security engineer who will own the data handling deep dive and answer any KMS or data flow questions with Acme's Alex. Mina — mind introducing yourself briefly so Acme has your day/time availability for a technical call?

I'll set the kickoff for Thu 4/16 10:00am PT and share a calendar invite with a short agenda: MAP walkthrough, owners & dates, evidence expectations, technical deep dive schedule.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Manager, GRC Enablement
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-2701

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@acmetech.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Park <elena.park@acmetech.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@acmetech.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan & SOC2 evidence — kickoff and GRC introductions

Appreciate the quick turnaround, everyone.

A couple quick items from Acme GRC:
1) Evidence priority — please start with the following artifacts in order: SOC 2 report (or Type II attestation), encryption and KMS config summary, user access review logs for the last 90 days, and retention/backup policy excerpts.
2) We're aiming for an internal sign-off by 5/8 to align with our vendor onboarding window. If Redwood can deliver the prioritized artifacts and the technical deep dive by 4/24, that should keep us on track.

Elena will coordinate contract redlines. For the MAP execution, can you send a DocuSign version of the MAP (signature block + acceptance criteria) once you've finalized the owners? If possible, send that to me and Elena directly.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Sanjay Rao
Manager, Governance Risk & Compliance
Acme Technologies
sanjay.rao@acmetech.com | +1 (415) 555-2222
